publicationBlockers.resolution: Review completed for #160. The installed ESP (SHA-256 5D65CFB1..., 809,886 bytes) was parsed on 2026-09-02: ESL-flagged, 559 records, all overrides (551 CELL, 8 WRLD), 0 new forms, 10 masters; the mod folder holds only the ESP and meta.ini, so no vendor asset is carried. Basis: distribution-only override patch (project standing rule); Lux 43158 explicitly permits compatibility patches carrying none of its assets; Water for ENB 37061's restrictive grid governs its files and assets, none of which the ESP modifies or contains; the generator is mindflux's own GPL-3.0-only patcher (Ensrick fork f7d459b, records/source-builds/ensrick-lux-water-cs-patch.json). Classified `distributable`; the recorded recipe remains the fallback.
